details: For finite concept classes; the stated $|\mathcal H|$ bound is deliberately weak by one query.
proof: For a finite class, repeatedly propose any remaining concept as a proper equivalence query. A counterexample eliminates that proposal, so after at most $|\mathcal H|-1$ failed queries one concept remains and is identified. Hence the complexity is at most $|\mathcal H|$.
name: Size / Proper Equivalence Queries Complexity
